shortDescription: Glencore Plc and InfraVia Capital Partners are among suitors for a stake in Eramet SA’s lithium operation in Argentina, according to Bloomberg.The French miner is seeking to sell assets to reduce debt, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Glencore, InfraVia Among Bidders for Eramet’s Argentina Lithium Stake
